name: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the electrical instrumentation industry in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers energy meters and charging piles, as well as AMI, smart charging operations, and smart water meter solutions. It also provides smart metering and collection systems; intelligent power terminals and systems; intelligent flow meter and systems; intelligent power distribution products and systems; IoT smart water meter and smart water services; and IoT products, including IoT sensors and accessories, and integrated energy service solutions.
